entries.name: Spellbook
entries.summary: 面向律师的 AI 法律起草与合同审阅工具，集成在 Microsoft Word 中，支持起草新条款、复用文档库语言及直接修改当前文档。

leaf_matches.reason: 官方 Draft 功能说明其识别当前文档并起草相关语言，可从空白文档起草，也支持把建议直接应用到文档；官方 About 说明产品在 Word 内工作，匹配律师持续处理中的可编辑文书工作流。

entries.name: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: GitHub Copilot 提供 GitHub.com 上的聊天与云端编码代理，可理解代码仓库、计划和实现多步代码任务、运行测试并发起拉取请求。

leaf_matches.reason: GitHub 官方 Chat 文档说明 Copilot Chat 在仓库、文件或代码片段上下文中回答问题、解释代码、提出改进或生成测试；用户从聊天获得建议后自行审阅和应用。此匹配仅针对建议/问答功能，不依据云代理代执行任务。

entries.name: Moderne Platform
entries.summary: Moderne 是面向企业多仓库代码现代化的私有 SaaS 平台，可跨组织仓库运行迁移/重构 recipes、检查结果并提交变更或创建拉取请求。

leaf_matches.reason: Moderne 官方资料明确描述企业级 SaaS 可跨组织多仓库运行自动化代码转换 recipes，查看变更结果并选择提交或创建 PR；因此属于代码迁移和现代化的可管理服务工作流。

entries.name: Amazon Aurora DSQL Playground
entries.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL 提供免 AWS 账户的浏览器 playground，开发者可在临时数据库环境中创建 schema、载入样例数据并执行 SQL 查询，用于交互式试用与学习。

leaf_matches.reason: AWS 官方公告明确描述即开即用、临时的数据库环境，以及浏览器内建 schema、数据和查询实验工作流，直接符合数据库沙箱子工作流。

entries.name: GitHub Dependabot
entries.summary: GitHub Dependabot tracks declared project dependencies and creates pull requests for configured version updates and security fixes.

leaf_matches.reason: 官方 Dependabot options reference 明确说明版本更新 PR 修改 manifest 与 lock files 中记录的版本，versioning-strategy 可 increase/widen 约束；安全更新覆盖 lock files 中的脆弱依赖，并可更新 transitive dependency（例如升级 parent 以允许修复 child）。因此证据覆盖约束、锁文件及传递依赖维护，而不只是通知。

entries.name: Renesas QuickConnect Studio
entries.summary: Renesas QuickConnect Studio 是浏览器内的嵌入式软硬件开发环境，支持构建、配置与调试 MCU 应用并连接远程开发板。

leaf_matches.reason: Renesas 官方 QuickConnect 文档将 Studio 描述为在浏览器内创建、配置、编译和调试嵌入式应用的平台，并提供远程调试目标板工作流，符合固件 IDE 子类型。

entries.name: Expo Application Services
entries.summary: Expo 提供 React Native 移动应用框架及云端 EAS Build/Submit 服务，支持构建、签名并向 TestFlight、App Store 和 Google Play 分发应用。

leaf_matches.reason: Expo 官方开发流程说明 Expo 是 React Native 开源框架（CLI、Router、SDK等）并与托管 EAS Build/Submit/Update、Workflows 整合；项目创建文档确认 Android/iOS framework/UI开发及原生模块，EAS资料覆盖云构建签名、测试分发、更新和上架。该匹配是 framework + EAS 套件整体，不把单独 EAS Build 当完整平台。

entries.name: Google Cloud Profiler
entries.summary: Google Cloud Profiler 持续收集生产程序的 CPU 与内存分配数据，并在 Google Cloud 控制台按代码位置查看和分析性能 profile。

leaf_matches.reason: Google Cloud 官方文档说明代理持续采样程序运行时资源开销，控制台把 CPU/内存指标归因到源代码并提供 profile 分析界面，符合运行测量、代码归因和持久 profile 探查核心。

entries.name: BrowserStack Automate
entries.summary: BrowserStack 提供托管真实浏览器与移动设备测试云，可在 Selenium 等自动化框架上并行执行网站测试并查看结果。

leaf_matches.reason: BrowserStack 官方产品页描述自动化测试运行网格、跨浏览器/设备的并行执行和结果反馈；与网页声明的测试管理及报告能力组合，构成自动化测试平台工作流。

entries.name: Replit
entries.summary: Replit Agent 通过浏览器工作台从提示生成网站或 web app，提供即时预览并支持将完成应用部署为公开网址。

leaf_matches.reason: Replit Agent 官方文档说明可由自然语言描述创建 web app、编写代码并设置基础设施；Project Editor 文档确认可打开和编辑项目文件；Publishing 文档说明在工作台发布并为应用分配 .replit.app 网址，部署类型文档覆盖云端 web app/API 运行。因此 Replit 提供从提示构建、编辑到发布可访问 web 应用的完整子工作流。

entries.name: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints
entries.summary: Hugging Face 托管专用推理端点，可部署 Hub 模型到其管理的云计算资源并提供受控 API。

leaf_matches.reason: 官方配置文档说明从 Hub 选择模型、由平台管理 AWS/Azure/GCP compute 部署，提供端点访问控制、GPU选择和自动伸缩。

entries.name: Check Point AI Guardrails (Lakera Guard)
entries.summary: Lakera Guard 提供面向生成式 AI 请求的运行时安全检测 API 和策略管理。

leaf_matches.reason: 官方资料描述在 LLM 应用路径中对提示注入、数据泄漏和内容违规进行实时检测并返回处理结果；符合 API 请求 screening 子工作流。

entries.name: AWS Database Migration Service
entries.summary: AWS DMS 提供数据库全量加载和持续变更捕获/复制任务，将源端变化应用到目标端。

leaf_matches.reason: 官方文档说明 DMS 从数据库原生变更日志持续捕获变化并交付至目标；与 CDC 核心匹配。
官方文档明确 full load + CDC 和 CDC-only 两类任务可把现有状态及后续变化持续应用到目标数据库。

entries.name: Snowflake
entries.summary: Snowflake 是由平台管理存储与弹性 SQL compute 的云数据分析平台，支持集中存储、查询和治理分析数据。

leaf_matches.reason: 官方架构文档说明持久化数据存储、平台提供的虚拟仓库集群和 SQL 分析服务，符合托管数据仓库核心。

entries.name: Databricks Lakehouse
entries.summary: Databricks 提供基于 Delta Lake 与 Apache Iceberg 表的受管 lakehouse 存储、目录治理和分析工作负载。

leaf_matches.reason: 官方产品页说明单一 Delta/Iceberg 数据副本、集中目录治理，并支持流批和交互式分析查询。

entries.name: Pinecone
entries.summary: Pinecone 是托管向量检索平台，支持通过 REST API/客户端进行向量相似度查询并返回排序结果。

leaf_matches.reason: 官方教程呈现文本 query embedding、向量检索及按语义相似度排序结果的闭环。
官方资料说明 Pinecone 是托管向量数据库，通过 API 查询向量并返回相似度排名结果。

entries.name: Stardog Semantic AI Platform
entries.summary: Stardog 提供企业知识图谱建模、数据虚拟化/物化、质量约束和图查询应用平台。

leaf_matches.reason: 官方产品资料明确覆盖跨数据源图谱构建、语义关系、治理/质量和 SPARQL/GraphQL 查询服务。

entries.name: Dify
entries.summary: Dify 是 AI 应用与 RAG 工作流平台，提供可管理知识管线并供工作流/聊天/agent应用检索。

leaf_matches.reason: Dify 官方知识管线产品页描述从文件/数据源建立维护知识库，再由 AI 应用检索并使用引用，覆盖 RAG 的摄取、检索和生成集成工作流。

entries.name: n8n Cloud
entries.summary: n8n Cloud 提供可视化工作流编辑器及 AI Agent 节点，用户可定义 agent 提示、模型和工具，并构建由 agent 调用其他 agent 的工作流。

leaf_matches.reason: n8n 官方 AI Agent 节点文档说明用户在工作流画布配置 agent，并连接 Chat Model、Memory 和 Tool 子节点；n8n 官方产品文档记录 Cloud 托管版本，形成定义、测试及运行 agent 的完整子工作流。
n8n 官方 AI Agent Tool 节点文档说明根 agent 可把其他 agent 作为 tools 调用，用于多 agent orchestration；workflow canvas 执行协调结构。

entries.name: RAGFlow

license_review.rationale: GitHub repository metadata reports repository SPDX Apache-2.0; official raw LICENSE snapshot is the full Apache License 2.0 text (11,357 bytes).

entries.summary: RAGFlow is a full self-hostable RAG application and engine for document ingestion, knowledge compilation, retrieval and grounded-answer workflows.
features: Ingests heterogeneous documents and performs document understanding, template-based chunking, and knowledge compilation.
Provides multi-step agentic retrieval with evidence verification, grounded citations and configurable LLM/embedding models.
Exposes APIs for integrating maintained knowledge and retrieval workflows into applications.
deployment: README documents Docker Compose deployment for production/evaluation and source deployment for development; Docker path starts server services and dependencies (MySQL, object store, message bus, vector/document engine). No code was executed.
technology_stack: Go backend services; GitHub language statistics list Go, TypeScript, C++, Python, C.
README documents React frontend development with Node.js/npm and Go services; GitHub API languages additionally show TypeScript and C++ as substantial repository languages.

leaf_matches.reason: RAGFlow README identifies an open-source RAG engine/application and directly documents document ingestion/understanding, chunking, configurable LLM and embedding, multi-step retrieval, evidence-grounded citations and application APIs; deployment section documents Docker Compose production deployment. This is the full RAG development workflow, not a vector database component.

entries.name: Grafana Pyroscope

license_review.rationale: GitHub metadata identifies GNU Affero GPL v3.0; the official raw LICENSE snapshot contains the full AGPL v3 text (34,523 bytes).

entries.summary: Grafana Pyroscope is an open-source continuous profiling platform that stores and queries application profiles and exposes line-level CPU, memory, and I/O performance analysis.
features: Collects continuous profiling data from application SDKs or profiling agents.
Stores and processes profiles and serves profile queries; users can compare profiles and inspect flame graphs/line-level performance findings.
Supports production continuous profiling across application services and multiple supported languages.
deployment: README documents running the server with Docker (`docker run -p 4040:4040 grafana/pyroscope`) and links to Kubernetes deployment documentation; no code was executed.
technology_stack: Go server and agents; GitHub language statistics report Go as the dominant language, plus TypeScript/JavaScript frontend assets.
Profiles can be sent by Pyroscope SDKs, Grafana Alloy, or OpenTelemetry-compatible sources per README.

leaf_matches.reason: GitHub README describes Pyroscope as a continuous profiling platform for CPU, memory and I/O, with server-side profile storage/query and line-level performance drilldown; it documents running server via Docker. This matches runtime profiling and profile exploration rather than logs or traces.

entries.name: Portkey AI Gateway (PRISMA AIRS)
entries.summary: Portkey provides a managed AI Gateway for routing requests across model providers, configurable failover, caching, virtual-key management, monitoring and governance.

leaf_matches.reason: Portkey official product page says its gateway dynamically switches models, distributes workloads and configures failover rules, uses virtual keys to control provider access, and provides centralized monitoring/governance. Product docs fetch had TLS EOF; the official product-page snapshot itself supplies the route/failover/control evidence.

entries.name: Feast

license_review.rationale: GitHub metadata declares Apache-2.0; official raw LICENSE snapshot is the complete Apache License Version 2.0 text (11,358 bytes).

entries.summary: Feast is an open-source feature store that catalogs feature definitions, supports point-in-time-correct training datasets, and serves online feature values through its feature server.
features: Maintains version-controlled feature definitions and registry metadata.
Builds point-in-time-correct historical training datasets from the offline store and serves latest entity-keyed feature values from the online store.
Provides Python SDK/CLI and a deployable REST feature server; supports batch and streaming ingestion patterns.
deployment: README documents pip installation and end-to-end local feature-store workflow, and lists Kubernetes production deployment plus Python feature server options; users deploy/configure their online/offline backing stores. No code was executed.
technology_stack: Python SDK/CLI and feature server; GitHub API language statistics show Python as primary, with Go, TypeScript and Java for additional components.
Backs registry/online/offline stores with external infrastructure configured by the operator.

leaf_matches.reason: Official README and components docs describe a registry for feature definitions, historical offline store for point-in-time-correct training data, low-latency online serving and feature server returning entity feature values. README also describes install/deploy workflows, including Kubernetes and API serving. This is the feature-store loop, not just a transformation library.

entries.name: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
entries.summary: AWS Managed Service for Apache Flink runs continuous streaming applications and provides hosted infrastructure for SQL, Python, Scala or Java stream analytics.

leaf_matches.reason: AWS official docs describe applications reading unbounded streams, applying user code/SQL transformations and continuously writing results to destinations; AWS hosts the runtime, scaling and durable state.

AWS official docs describe interactive real-time stream queries and dashboards/metrics, plus deploying Studio code into a long-running application that continuously reads streams, writes destinations and retains state. This matches a continuous analytics workflow rather than a generic event broker.

entries.name: Elasticsearch
entries.summary: Elasticsearch is a search platform that indexes supplied content and serves programmatic search queries with relevance-ranked results.

leaf_matches.reason: Elastic official Search documentation describes indexing content and querying it through the search API; Elasticsearch returns ranked hits and functions as a platform for applications to embed search.
